normalization_plan.reason: amountIn is only a formal parameter of getAmountsOut and should be merged into that function node.
reserveIn is a parameter of the external quote function and has no standalone semantic value.
reserveOut is a parameter of the external quote function and can be merged into it.
amountToSwap is an argument of the internal swap helper and should be merged into it.
minAmountOut only parameterizes the slippage check of the swap helper.
assetToSwapFrom is a parameter consumed directly by the swap helper.
assetToSwapTo is a parameter consumed directly by the swap helper.
useEthPath only selects the routing branch inside the swap helper.
permitSignature is only meaningful for the permit step of _pullAToken.
initiator is the flash loan initiator supplied to executeOperation and forwarded downstream.
params is only the raw payload decoded by _decodeParams.
decodedParams is a transient local built and consumed inside the executeOperation flow.
debtToCover parameterizes the liquidation call amount inside _liquidateAndSwap.
collateralAsset selects the asset handled by the liquidation swap logic.
borrowedAsset selects the debt asset repaid by the liquidation logic.
results is the local AmountCalc returned by the getAmountsOut wrapper.
user is the position argument of the liquidation operation and merges into it.
